text:
alex (PM): quick one — putting the in-product docs sidecar into the dashboard iteration. want to align terminology and linking behavior before we ship :eyes:

maya (Design): nice. main question: do we call it `Docs` or `Help panel` in the UI? we have mixed usage in mocks.

jonathan (Eng): prefer `Docs` as a single token — shorter for the button. but linking needs to be deterministic for routing. if we do `Docs` we can map route /docs/* easily.

maya (Design): ok, `Docs` works. just want the header copy to read: "Docs & examples" so it's discoverable.

samira (Accessibility): +1 to a clear header. also make sure the toggle is focusable and has aria-expanded state. currently the mock uses a div styled as button.

jonathan (Eng): noted. i'll swap to a button role and wire up `aria-expanded="false"` initially. sample: `<button aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"docs-sidecar\">Docs</button>`.

kevin (Analytics): do we want to track which doc links are clicked inside the sidecar? that'll help us prioritize content. suggest data-attributes like `data-doc-id`.

maya (Design): yes please. also, let's keep cross-links consistent with console docs pages — same slug structure. examples: `/docs/runtime/batching` and `/docs/console/rollouts`. avoid deep contextual anchors.

jonathan (Eng): implementation detail: our router currently treats `/docs` as client route; linking to `/docs/console/rollouts` should do a soft nav. if we need external docs (help.redwood.ai) we can open in new tab.

samira (Accessibility): opening in new tab must have `rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"` and visible hint like `opens in new tab` for screen reader — or we can set `aria-label` with that info.

maya (Design): on tiny screens the sidecar collapses into a help icon. suggestion: show the top 3 most-clicked doc links (we can feed this from analytics) — saves space.

kevin (Analytics): we can backfill a small endpoint to return top links per org. proto: `GET /api/analytics/top-doc-links?org_id=...` returns top 3 slugs.

jonathan (Eng): sounds doable. i'll punt on the endpoint but we can default to curated links in the product until analytics is ready.

design-bot: uploaded image: https://assets.prod.redwood.ai/sidecar-wireframe-v3.png

maya (Design): uploaded new wireframe (v3). i've changed label to `Docs` and header to `Docs & examples`. also added small pill text `opens in new tab` on external links.

samira (Accessibility): quick a11y nit: color contrast on the pill is 3.8:1 currently, needs to be >=4.5:1 for small text.

maya (Design): good catch — i'll darken the pill background.

jonathan (Eng): question: how should inline code samples in the sidecar be rendered? fixed-width box or collapsible?

maya (Design): fixed-width inline boxes for short snippets (1 line), expandable for longer examples. ensure keyboard toggle for expand.

samira (Accessibility): collapsible code must be focusable and announce expanded/collapsed state to AT.

kevin (Analytics): last thought — track `docs_sidecar_open`, `docs_link_click` with `doc_slug` and `source: sidecar`. that'll give us the usage curve.

alex (PM): awesome, plan: maya will update the mock with contrast fix and pill copy; jonathan will implement accessible button + analytics hooks; kevin will stand up the analytics endpoint prototype; samira will review once accessible markup is in staging. please ack if that's accurate. :thumbsup:

maya (Design): ack.

jonathan (Eng): ack, adding to my sprint.

kevin (Analytics): ack, will prototype next week.

samira (Accessibility): ack, i'll do a pass after deploy to staging.

alex (PM): thanks all. i'll update the PR description with the agreed terms and link to the wireframe: https://assets.prod.redwood.ai/sidecar-wireframe-v3.png

jonathan (Eng): FYI i pushed a small CSS tweak to ensure the button gets `:focus` outline in dark mode.

maya (Design): saw it, looks good.

alex (PM): final microcopy for the header we'll ship: `Docs & examples` and button label `Docs`. cross-link format `/docs/<section>/<topic>` and external links open new tab with hint. that's the spec i'm putting in the ticket.

samira (Accessibility): thanks — pls add the a11y checklist to the ticket (keyboard, aria-expanded, aria-controls, focus styles, contrast).

alex (PM): done — ticket updated. will loop back after staging verification. :rocket:
